text: I (Pritam umar) No. P-45021/112/2020-PP (BE-II)/003 Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Public Procurement Section) Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi Dated Dec. 20, 2021 Registration Certificate to M/s Econess Energy Co. Ltd. The undersigned is directed to refer to application of Mis Econess Energy Co. Ltd. no. NIL dated 09.12 .2020 seeking registration in accordance with Department of Expenditure Order No . F. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23.07 .2020 and to convey that competent authority has approved grant of registration on the following terms and conditions to the entity mentioned below: Name of the applicant entity M/s Econess Energy Co. Ltd. Registered Office/Complete address o1 the manufacturing premises No. 58 , Haida Road, Huashi own , Jiangyin , Jiangsu Province, China, Chaoson Zhao ltem/s for which registration is granted Poly PV Solar Cells Validity of registration 03 years from the date of issue of this certificate, i.e ., 19th December 2024 2. The Registration is only for the purpose of participation in public procurement in India in accordance with DoE Order (Public Procurement No . 1) dated 23 .07.2020 for supply of items (goods/ works/ services) from the premises mentioned above. 3. In case of appointment of new Director(s)/shareholders with more than 10% shares /change in controlling ownership interest or control through other means, this Registration shall automatically stand annulled . To, M/s Econess Energy Co. Ltd. Under Secretary to Government of India E-mail: pritam.k@gov.in Ph :-011 -23061306 Address: No. 58 , Haida Road , Huashi Town , Jiangyin, Jiangsu Province, China, Contact Person: Mr. Chaoson Zhao, +86 15921541978, Email: chaoson .zhao@eco-pv.com -- 1 of 1 --
